purpose: Generic bilingual offline patient announcement fallbacks for Scrubssitel. Replaces earlier macOS system-voice exports.

generator.name: eSpeak NG
generator.method: Built-in formant synthesis: de and en-us. No MBROLA or external/neural voice models.

audio.encoder: macOS afconvert (format conversion only, no system speech voices)

licenseNotes.engine: The synthesis tool and its distribution use GPL-3.0-or-later. The tool is run offline and is not included in these audio assets or the game.
licenseNotes.generatedOutput: These original short announcement texts were supplied for the game and converted into speech using built-in formant voices. Per GPL v3 section 2 and the GNU GPL FAQ, output does not automatically inherit the tool license; this output-use assessment is an inference from that rule and the documented synthesis method, not a separately issued eSpeak output license. No Apple system-voice export, MBROLA voice, commercial voice model, or human recording was used.
